svg.title: Kyra R1 — ring, engineering drawing
svg.text: SHELL, ZIRCONIA OR Ti, POTTED, NO INDICATOR
TOUCH STRIP, 3 CH + GUARD, OUTER FACE
1. DIMENSIONS IN MM. SCALE 2:1 ON A4. THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION.
2. US SIZE 9 SHOWN: ID 18.9. BAND 2.8 × 8.0. SIZES 6–13 (A8).
3. NO MICROPHONE, NO CAMERA, NO OPTICAL OR ELECTRICAL BIOSENSOR (KYR-002).
4. PRODUCTION FORM FACTOR FOR CONTEXT ONLY; EV1 IS A 20 × 20 RIGID
BOARD (BRIEF-ring-ev1.md §MECHANICAL). HIDDEN LINES: PARTS IN THE BAND.
